vector_memory.semantic_summary: This module is the FrameData Builder, responsible for aggregating all necessary rendering information for a single frame draw call. The core function, buildFrameData, processes the Scene and Camera to filter and sort entities into specific lists: opaque, transparent, skybox, and shadow casters. It calculates view-projection matrices and uses frustum culling to ensure only visible entities are included in the final FrameData structure, which is then passed to rendering passes.
